5 04-03-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The instant application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 7783 (C) of 2023 instituted for the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. As per allegation in the FIR, it is a case of matrimonial dispute.
Petitioner snatched the belongings of his wife and ousted her.
Complainant is residing at her maika with Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.53318 of 2024(5) dt.04-03-2025 her two daughters.
4. Earlier vide order dated 26.10.2024, this matter was referred to Patna High Court Mediation Center for settlement of matrimonial dispute between the parties.

5. After successful mediation, Mediator sent a report, which is kept at flag 'M' from which it appears that dispute between the parties has been resolved through the process of mediation and they mutually agreed to live together happily with their two daughters.

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel appearing for both the parties have submitted that petitioner and opposite party no. 2 are living together as husband and wife.
7. In para 3 of Memorandum of Agreement, both the parties are agreed upon that any case filed against each other shall be withdraw by each of the party.

8. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and in view of Memorandum of Agreement between the parties mentioned in Mediation Proceeding No. 1743 of 2024, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on provisional bail.

The petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within a period of six weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender in connection with Complaint Case No. 7783 (C) of Patna High Court CR.

9.

10. Trial Court is directed to confirm the provisional bail granted to the petitioner after verifying the terms and conditions mentioned in Memorandum of Agreement and also verifying the withdrawal of all the pending cases against each other.
